sanskrit_verse:
कृताग्निकार्यो भुञ्जीत वाग्यतो गुर्वनुज्ञया ।
आपोशानक्रियापूर्वं सत्कृत्यान्नमकुत्सयन् ॥३१॥
transliteration: kṛtāgnikāryo bhuñjīta vāgyato gurvanujñayā / āpośānakriyāpūrvaṃ satkṛtyānnam akutsayan // YajñS_1.31
sph_interpretive_translation: One who has performed the fire ritual shall consume food only after honoring the Guru through verbal acknowledgment, prior to drinking water, and having respectfully offered the food without disdain.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from ritual completion and spiritual hierarchy
Causation is established through sequential acts of reverence and purification
Capacity-based responsibility requires conscious alignment with dharmic order before sustenance
Restoration logic mandates that consumption aligns individual consciousness with cosmic law
Consciousness alignment occurs through disciplined observance of precedence and respect
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent.hasPerformedRitual('agnikarya') AND NOT agent.hasHonoredGuru THEN agent.consumeFood = FALSE
IF agent.offersFood() THEN agent.mustOfferWithRespect() == TRUE ELSE violation.ofDharmicSequence = TRUE
supreme_court_application: In matters involving ritual conduct and spiritual authority, the Supreme Court must recognize precedence of guru-disciple relationships and enforce adherence to sequential dharmic actions as foundational to lawful behavior. Responsibility arises from capacity to uphold dharma, not mere intent.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that causality in action lies in alignment with sequential dharmic observances. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures that misalignment does not invoke punishment but necessitates completion-process. Proportional responsibility correlates with disruption of consciousness-order; hence restoration replaces punitive measures.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: CompletionProcess: Re-perform agnikarya with proper guru acknowledgment
CapacityRestoration: Engage in satkara until purity of intention is verified
IntegrityReintegration: Offer food again with full awareness and absence of disdain
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Dharma is restored. Consciousness alone is the adjudicator. There is no punishment—only realignment.
